description: A gene takes part as a DNA entity in a Reactome biochemical reaction, as an input, an output, or both. Participation does not distinguish these roles and does not represent catalysis or regulation.

common_properties.name: version
common_properties.description: Reactome release number in which the relationship was last present.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the relationship was created or last updated in SPOKE.

source_contributions.scope: Biochemical reactions in the human BioPAX export within Signaling Pathways (R-HSA-162582), Immune System (R-HSA-168256), and Diseases of signal transduction by growth factor receptors and second messengers (R-HSA-5663202), including their descendant pathways.
source_contributions.description: Only directly stated DNA inputs and outputs are represented. DNA entities correspond to existing Gene nodes carrying the same Ensembl gene identifier; if several Gene nodes share that identifier, each is linked. DNA without a matching Ensembl gene identifier, RNA entities, and alternative-member sets are excluded. Catalysts, regulators and active units do not establish participation. Input, output and both roles share one relationship per gene–reaction pair; role and stoichiometry are not recorded.
